It is a solution of an Einstein Maxwell theory plus charged massless fermions. The fermions give rise to a negative Casimir-like energy, which makes the wormhole possible. It is a long wormhole that does not lead to causality violations in the ambient space. It can be viewed as a pair of entangled near extremal black holes with an interaction term generated by the exchange of fermion fields. The solution can be embedded in the Standard Model by making its overall size small compared to the electroweak scale.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1088\/1361-6382\/acde30","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2023,6,13]],"date-time":"2023-06-13T18:40:25Z","timestamp":1686681625000},"page":"155016","update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1088\/crossmark-policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":56,"title":["Traversable wormholes in four dimensions"],"prefix":"10.1088","volume":"40","author":[{"given":"Juan","family":"Maldacena","sequence":"first","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-3707-4957","authenticated-orcid":true,"given":"Alexey","family":"Milekhin","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Fedor","family":"Popov","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"266","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2023,7,10]]},"reference":[{"key":"cqgacde30bib1","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","first-page":"1446","DOI":"10.1103\/PhysRevLett.61.1446","type":"journal-article","article-title":"Wormholes, time machines and the weak energy condition","volume":"61","author":"Morris","year":"1988","journal-title":"Phys. We concentrate on the case of nearly\u2010\n                    <jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink=\"http:\/\/www.w3.org\/1999\/xlink\" xlink:href=\"graphic\/prop201700034-math-0001.png\" xlink:title=\"urn:x-wiley:00158208:media:prop201700034:prop201700034-math-0001\"\/>\n                    gravity and discuss a very simple mechanical picture for the gravitational dynamics. BV","content-domain":{"domain":[],"crossmark-restriction":false},"abstract":"<jats:p>Traversable wormholes may one day provide a direct solution to dilated asynchronous intraorganizational communication (DAIC). This essay circumvents a discussion of exotic materials and assumes that it could be possible to engineer macroscopic, intrauniversal, traversable wormholes. The essay introduces useful notational conventions, analyzes a patch of basic wormhole geometry at an elementary level, and considers the consequences of the traveling executive traversing such a patch. If designed and utilized properly under the assumptions specified in this essay, a wormhole could reduce the executive\u2019s six-month information asymmetry down to roughly one hour.
